summary: Webuy Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing it received a Nasdaq notice of compliance with the Minimum Stockholders Equity Rule ($2,500,000 requirement) after demonstrating $3,291,706 in stockholders' equity as of its 2025 Form 20-F. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. The Nasdaq matter is now closed, with no material corporate event, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are involved. This report merely informs investors of continued listing compliance, ending any delisting risk.
